title: Shipment from label to delivery, with tracking events
description: How a parcel moves from label creation to delivery or return and how carrier tracking events are handled, as documented by Sendcloud and the DHL Shipment Tracking API.

provenance.reference: Official documentation, read and checked 2026-10-21: sendcloud.dev/docs/archive/tracking/tracking-statuses; support-developer.dhl.com/support/solutions/articles/47001197243-what-are-the-different-status-codes-available-in-the-dhl-shipment-tracking-unified-api-; support-developer.dhl.com/support/solu

requirements.statement: A shipment is created for an order with its parcels and a shipping label for the chosen carrier.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A shipment has one or more parcels and a carrier.
The label exists before the parcel is handed over.

requirements.statement: The label is announced to the carrier; if the carrier does not accept the announcement it is corrected and announced again.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The shipment shows whether it is announced.
A failed announcement can be corrected.

requirements.statement: A parcel that is ready to send is handed over: collected by the carrier's driver or dropped at a service point; if it is not collected another collection is arranged.
The carrier carries the parcel through sorting to the recipient; its progress, including customs checks, is reported as status events.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each event has a status, a time and a place.

requirements.statement: The delivery outcome is recorded: delivered, delivery attempt failed, waiting at a service point, or undeliverable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The outcome of the last delivery attempt is stored.

requirements.statement: When the recipient cannot be reached, a new delivery date is arranged; when the parcel waits at a service point the recipient collects it, and an uncollected parcel is returned.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A failed attempt leads to a new delivery date.
An uncollected parcel at a service point is returned.

requirements.statement: An undeliverable parcel because it is refused, the address is invalid or it cannot be delivered is returned to the sender.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The shipment is marked as returned to the sender.

requirements.statement: Each carrier event is recorded; where the carrier reports no simplified status or sends a late earlier-stage event, the shipment's status is taken from the carrier's status details rather than the event history.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An event the carrier cannot classify is kept as received.
A late pre-transit event does not move the shipment backwards.

requirements.statement: The recipient is notified of the shipment's progress.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A status change triggers a notification to the recipient.

requirements.statement: The full history of status events of every shipment is kept and can be searched.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every event of a shipment is visible in order.

rules.description: A label is announced to the carrier, or the announcement fails.
The parcel is collected by the driver or dropped at a service point, or it is announced but not collected.

source.reference: https://sendcloud.dev/docs/archive/tracking/tracking-statuses (Shipment picked up by driver; Announced: not collected; Error collecting)

rules.description: Delivery ends as delivered, a failed attempt (recipient unavailable), a wait at a service point, or undeliverable (refused, invalid address, unable to deliver).

source.reference: https://sendcloud.dev/docs/archive/tracking/tracking-statuses (Delivered; Delivery attempt failed; Awaiting customer pickup; Refused by recipient; Address invalid; Unable to deliver)

rules.description: A parcel waiting at a service point is collected by the customer, or it expires and is returned.

source.reference: https://support-developer.dhl.com/support/solutions/articles/47001197243-what-are-the-different-status-codes-available-in-the-dhl-shipment-tracking-unified-api- (Failure includes expiry when a recipient does not collect from a service point; Sendcloud: Shipment collected by customer)

rules.description: A carrier event is current, has no simplified status, or arrives late from an earlier stage.

source.reference: https://support-developer.dhl.com/support/solutions/articles/47001271948-i-m-receiving-a-delayed-pre-transit-status-event-once-the-shipment-is-already-in-transit-or-deli (Delayed pre-transit event; use the status details for the final outcome)

exceptions.name: Announcement failed
exceptions.trigger: The carrier did not accept the label announcement.
exceptions.recovery: The shipment details are corrected and the label is announced again.

exceptions.name: Parcel not collected
exceptions.trigger: The parcel was announced but the driver did not collect it, or collecting failed.
exceptions.recovery: Another collection is arranged and the handover is recorded again.

exceptions.name: Delivery attempt failed
exceptions.trigger: The recipient was not available to receive the parcel.
exceptions.recovery: A new delivery date is arranged and the carrier delivers again.

exceptions.name: Parcel waiting at a service point
exceptions.trigger: The parcel is at a service point waiting for the customer.
exceptions.recovery: The recipient collects the parcel; if it is not collected it is returned.

exceptions.name: Parcel undeliverable
exceptions.trigger: The recipient refused the parcel, the address is invalid, the parcel cannot be delivered, or it was not collected from a service point.
exceptions.recovery: The parcel is returned to the sender and the shipment ends.

exceptions.name: Status not classified
exceptions.trigger: The carrier reports no simplified status for an event.
exceptions.recovery: The event is kept as received and the shipment status is taken from the carrier's status details.

exceptions.name: Late earlier-stage event
exceptions.trigger: A pre-transit event arrives after the shipment is already in transit or delivered.
exceptions.recovery: The event is stored; the shipment's status is taken from the carrier's status details, not the event history.
